malformed: The PDF is truncated or malformed. Save a new PDF from the original document and upload it again
active: The PDF contains active content, forms, attachments, hidden content or external references. Remove these features or save a flattened static copy
revisions: This PDF has conflicting document revisions. Save a flattened copy as a new PDF and upload it
notPdf: This file is not a PDF
flate: Save this PDF with standard Flate compression and upload it again
prediction: Save this PDF without cross-reference prediction and upload it again
encrypted: Encrypted or password-protected PDFs are not supported
byteLimit: The PDF must be no larger than 10 MiB
malformedComplex: The PDF is malformed or too complex
unreadable: The PDF cannot be read; it may be malformed or password-protected
chained: The PDF uses chained object references. Save a flattened copy and upload it again
pageTree: The PDF page tree is malformed
pageCount: The PDF must contain between 1 and 20 pages
busy: PDF processing is busy; please retry shortly
